caseName: Tagoe v. Dist. of Columbia Dep't of Emp't Servs.
caseNameFull: Mary Anne TAGOE, aka Mary Anne Roberts v. DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA DEPARTMENT OF EMPLOYMENT SERVICES

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed *984until February 3, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
